assignedReviews.card_evidence: Add the atomic mass of one Na atom, 23 amu, to the atomic mass of one Cl atom, 35 amu, to get 58 amu.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: plan and carry out a scientific investigation to determine the effect of different surfaces on the size of frictional forces
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches calculating formula mass of NaCl using atomic masses, which is chemistry/stoichiometry. It provides no support for planning or carrying out an investigation about friction on different surfaces.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Add the atomic mass of one Na atom, 23 amu, to the atomic mass of one Cl atom, 35 amu, to get 58 amu.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify that forces act between objects and can be measured
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about formula mass calculation, not about forces acting between objects or measuring forces. It is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en:
How do you calculate the formula mass of NaCl?

Add the atomic mass of one Na atom, 23 amu, to the atomic mass of one Cl atom, 35 amu, to get 58 amu.
copy.tl:
Paano mo kinakalkula ang formula mass ng NaCl?

Idagdag ang atomic mass ng isang Na atom, 23 amu, sa atomic mass ng isang Cl atom, 35 amu, para makuha ang 58 amu.
copy.bis:
Giunsa nimo pagkwenta ang formula mass sa NaCl?

Idugang ang atomic mass sa usa ka Na atom, 23 amu, sa atomic mass sa usa ka Cl atom, 35 amu, para makuha ang 58 amu.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Pigs, goats, and carabaos have four legs
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the role of greenhouse gases in enhanced global warming and climate change
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes farm animals with four legs and their locomotion. It provides no information about greenhouse gases, global warming, or climate change, which is the subject of G10-E-9.

copy.en:
Which farm animals have four legs?

Pigs, goats, and carabaos have four legs, and they use all four legs for walking and running.
copy.tl:
Aling mga alagang hayop sa bukid ang may apat na paa?

Ang baboy, kambing, at kalabaw ay may apat na paa, at ginagamit nila ang lahat ng apat na paa sa paglalakad at pagtakbo.
copy.bis:
Unsang mga mananap sa uma ang adunay upat ka tiil?

Ang baboy, kanding, ug kabaw adunay upat ka tiil, ug gigamit nila ang tanang upat ka tiil sa paglakaw ug pagdagan.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The displacement of a free-falling object increases with time, and you can compute it using the equation d equals one half g t squared.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain that genetic information is passed on to offspring from both parents by the process of meiosis and fertilization
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches the physics formula for free-fall displacement, which is unrelated to genetic information transfer via meiosis and fertilization.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The displacement of a free-falling object increases with time, and you can compute it using the equation d equals one half g t squared.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: differentiate sexual from asexual reproduction in terms of: a) number of parents involved, and b) similarities of offspring to parents
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about free-fall displacement, not about differentiating sexual from asexual reproduction.

copy.en: The displacement of a free-falling object increases with time, and you can compute it using the equation d equals one half g t squared.
copy.tl: Ang displacement ng bagay sa free-fall ay tumataas habang tumatagal, at maaari mo itong kuwentahin gamit ang equation na d ay katumbas ng kalahating g t squared.
copy.bis: Ang displacement sa butang sa free-fall motaas samtang modugay, ug makwenta nimo kini gamit ang equation nga d katumbas sa tunga sa g t squared.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A wave's frequency is how many waves pass a point in one second, and when frequency increases, the energy of the wave also increases.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate how different factors affect the solubility of a solute in a given solvent, such as heat
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses wave frequency and energy, which is a physics topic. G7-M-10 is about demonstrating factors affecting solubility of a solute in a solvent, a chemistry/matter topic. No instructional support for solubility.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A wave's frequency is how many waves pass a point in one second, and when frequency increases, the energy of the wave also increases.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures, such as solutions and suspensions
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about wave frequency and energy, unrelated to uniform and non-uniform mixtures, solutions, or suspensions. G6-M-4 is a matter/mixtures competency; the card provides no support for it.

copy.en:
Do faster vibrating electromagnetic waves carry more energy?

Yes! Electromagnetic waves that vibrate more times per second, meaning higher frequency, carry more energy than slower ones.
copy.tl:
Mas marami bang energy ang mas mabilis na electromagnetic waves?

Oo! Ang electromagnetic waves na mas mabilis mag-vibrate bawat segundo o mas mataas na frequency ay nagdadala ng mas maraming energy kaysa sa mas mabagal.
copy.bis:
Mas daghan ba og energy ang mas paspas nga electromagnetic waves?

Oo! Ang electromagnetic waves nga mas paspas mo-vibrate kada segundo o mas taas nga frequency nagdala og mas daghan nga energy kaysa sa mas hinay.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Freshwater is used for drinking, cooking, cleaning, washing, bathing, and many other household chores we do every day.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and labeled diagrams the parts of the digestive system as mouth, gullet, stomach, small intestine, and large intestine, and describe how they work
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes household uses of freshwater; it contains no information about the digestive system, its parts, or how they work.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Freshwater is used for drinking, cooking, cleaning, washing, bathing, and many other household chores we do every day.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: using a labeled diagram, trace how food travels through the digestive tract and explain how different digestive processes work, including mechanical processing, secretion, digestion, absorption, and elimination
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about freshwater household uses and does not trace food through the digestive tract or explain digestive processes.

copy.en: Freshwater is used for drinking, cooking, cleaning, washing, bathing, and many other household chores we do every day.
copy.tl: Ang freshwater ay ginagamit sa pag-inom, pagluluto, paglilinis, paglalaba, pagligo, at marami pang ibang gawaing bahay araw-araw.
copy.bis: Ang freshwater ginagamit sa pag-inom, pagluto, pagpanglimpyo, paglaba, pagkaligo, ug daghan pang uban nga buluhaton sa balay kada adlaw.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: friction between the tires and the road, and air resistance, work together to oppose its motion
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify differences and similarities between longitudinal waves and transverse waves
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about friction and air resistance opposing a car's motion. G6-F-7 concerns identifying differences and similarities between longitudinal and transverse waves. Friction is not a wave phenomenon, and the card provides no information about wave types.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: friction between the tires and the road, and air resistance, work together to oppose its motion
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify some examples of longitudinal waves, and transverse waves
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about friction and air resistance opposing a car's motion. G6-F-9 concerns identifying examples of longitudinal and transverse waves. The card gives no wave examples and is unrelated to wave concepts.

copy.en: A car slows down after a ride because friction between the tires and the road, and air resistance, work together to oppose its motion.
copy.tl: Bumabagal ang isang kotse pagkatapos ng biyahe dahil ang friction sa pagitan ng mga gulong at kalsada, at ang air resistance, ay nagtutulungan upang salungatin ang galaw nito.
copy.bis: Mohinay ang usa ka kotse pagkahuman sa biyahe tungod kay ang friction tali sa mga ligid ug dalan, ug ang air resistance, magtinabangay aron supakon ang lihok niini.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Can you find percent composition without a chemical formula?
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the parts and functions, and demonstrate proper handling and storing of a compound microscope
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches how to calculate percent composition from mass data, a chemistry topic. G7-L-1 is about identifying parts and functions of a compound microscope and proper handling/storing. There is no connection to microscopes or living things.

copy.en:
Can you find percent composition without a chemical formula?

Yes, if you know the mass of each element in a sample, you can divide each by the total mass and multiply by 100.
copy.tl:
Makakakuha ka ba ng percent composition kahit walang chemical formula?

Oo, kung alam mo ang masa ng bawat elemento sa isang sample, maaari mong hatiin ang bawat isa sa kabuuang masa at i-multiply sa 100.
copy.bis:
Makakuha ka ba sa percent composition bisan walay chemical formula?

Oo, kung nahibalo ka sa masa sa matag elemento sa usa ka sample, mahimo nimo bahina ang matag usa sa kinatibuk-ang masa ug i-multiply sa 100.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: clouds, icebergs, and glaciers, which store freshwater in frozen form
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use models, flow charts, diagrams, and simulations to explain how body systems work together, such as digestion and excretion
assignedReviews.reason: Frozen water sources are not body systems working together.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: clouds, icebergs, and glaciers
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and diagrams the parts of the respiratory system as the nose, windpipe, and lungs, and describe how they work
assignedReviews.reason: Frozen water is not nose, windpipe, and lungs.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: store freshwater in frozen form
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and diagrams the parts of the circulatory system as heart, blood, and blood vessels, and describe how they work
assignedReviews.reason: Icebergs and glaciers are unrelated to the circulatory system.

copy.en: Other sources of water include clouds, icebergs, and glaciers, which store freshwater in frozen form.
copy.tl: Kabilang sa iba pang sources ng tubig ang mga ulap, iceberg, at glacier, na nag-iimbak ng freshwater sa anyong yelo.
copy.bis: Lakip sa uban pang sources sa tubig ang mga panganod, iceberg, ug glacier, nga nagtipig ug freshwater sa porma nga yelo.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The ripening of a fruit is a chemical change because its color, taste, and odor change as new substances form inside it.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how soil is formed from rocks and minerals
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses fruit ripening as a chemical change, which is unrelated to the competency about explaining how soil is formed from rocks and minerals. No instructional support for soil formation is present.

copy.en: The ripening of a fruit is a chemical change because its color, taste, and odor change as new substances form inside it.
copy.tl: Ang paghinog ng prutas ay isang chemical change dahil ang kulay, lasa, at amoy nito ay nagbabago habang nabubuo ang mga bagong substance sa loob nito.
copy.bis: Ang pagkahinog sa prutas usa ka chemical change tungod kay ang kolor, lami, ug baho mausab samtang maporma ang bag-ong mga substance sa sulod.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: FSH, or follicle stimulating hormone, helps control the menstrual cycle and stimulates the growth of eggs inside the ovaries.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: recognize that scientists use models to explain phenomena that cannot be easily seen or detected
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a hormone's role in the menstrual cycle and egg growth. It contains no mention of models, modeling, or phenomena that cannot be easily seen or detected, which is the core of G7-M-1. The content is biology, not the matter/models topic of this competency.

copy.en: FSH, or follicle stimulating hormone, helps control the menstrual cycle and stimulates the growth of eggs inside the ovaries.
copy.tl: Ang FSH, o follicle stimulating hormone, ay tumutulong kontrolin ang menstrual cycle at pinasisigla ang paglaki ng mga itlog sa loob ng ovaries.
copy.bis: Ang FSH, o follicle stimulating hormone, motabang pagkontrol sa menstrual cycle ug mopadasig sa pagtubo sa mga itlog sa sulod sa ovaries.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Gasoline stations sell different octane grades like unleaded, super, and super-premium, with higher octane fuel being more stable under pressure.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: draw the structure of an atom in terms of the nucleus and electron shells
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses octane grades of gasoline, which is about fuel properties, not the structure of an atom (nucleus and electron shells). No instructional support for drawing atomic structure.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Gasoline stations sell different octane grades like unleaded, super, and super-premium, with higher octane fuel being more stable under pressure.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: differentiate the subatomic particles protons, neutrons, and electrons in terms of their symbol, mass, charge, and location within an atom
assignedReviews.reason: The card does not mention protons, neutrons, electrons, or their properties. It is about fuel octane ratings, unrelated to differentiating subatomic particles.

copy.en: Gasoline stations sell different octane grades like unleaded, super, and super-premium, with higher octane fuel being more stable under pressure.
copy.tl: Ang mga gasoline station ay nagbebenta ng iba't ibang octane grade tulad ng unleaded, super, at super-premium, kung saan mas stable ang mas mataas na octane fuel sa ilalim ng pressure.
copy.bis: Ang mga gasoline station nagbaligya ug lain-laing octane grade sama sa unleaded, super, ug super-premium, diin mas stable ang mas taas nga octane fuel ubos sa pressure.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The Full Moon looks low near the horizon
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: using a labeled diagram, trace how food travels through the digestive tract and explain how different digestive processes work, including mechanical processing, secretion, digestion, absorption, and elimination
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the apparent path of the Full Moon across the night sky. G8-L-1 requires tracing food through the digestive tract using a labeled diagram. There is no connection to digestion or any living-things content.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The Full Moon looks low near the horizon
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and labeled diagrams the parts of the digestive system as mouth, gullet, stomach, small intestine, and large intestine, and describe how they work
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about the Moon's motion, not about identifying parts of the digestive system. G5-L-1 requires identifying mouth, gullet, stomach, small intestine, and large intestine from pictures/diagrams. The card provides no support for this competency.

copy.en: The Full Moon looks low near the horizon in the early evening, climbs high in the sky at midnight, and moves down again before dawn.
copy.tl: Ang Full Moon ay mukhang mababa malapit sa horizon sa maagang gabi, umaakyat nang mataas sa langit sa hatinggabi, at bumababa muli bago mag-umaga.
copy.bis: Ang Full Moon morag ubos duol sa horizon sa sayong gabii, mosaka ug taas sa langit sa tungang gabii, ug mopaubos pag-usab sa dili pa magbuntag.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A functional group, which is a specific group of atoms attached to the carbon chain, gives the compound its chemical behavior and properties.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe that particles are constantly in motion, have spaces between them, attract each other, and move faster as the temperature increases (or with the addition of heat)
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses functional groups in organic compounds, which is unrelated to the particle model of matter (particle motion, spacing, attraction, temperature effects). No instructional support for G7-M-3.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A functional group, which is a specific group of atoms attached to the carbon chain, gives the compound its chemical behavior and properties.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain in terms of the particle model the processes underlying convection and conduction of heat energy
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about functional groups and chemical behavior, not about convection/conduction of heat energy explained via the particle model. No instructional support for G7-F-10.

copy.en:
What makes one organic compound different from another?

A functional group, which is a specific group of atoms attached to the carbon chain, gives the compound its chemical behavior and properties.
copy.tl:
Ano ang nagpapangyari na magkaiba ang isang organic compound sa iba?

Ang functional group, na isang partikular na grupo ng atoms na nakakabit sa carbon chain, ang nagbibigay sa compound ng kanyang kemikal na pag-uugali at mga katangian.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang nakapahimo nga lahi ang usa ka organic compound sa lain?

Ang functional group, nga usa ka partikular nga grupo sa atoms nga nakakabit sa carbon chain, ang naghatag sa compound sa iyang kemikal nga pamatasan ug mga kinaiya.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: reduce waste and keep it out of landfills
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe changes of state for solids, liquids, and gases as melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation using diagrams and flowcharts
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses reducing waste by refurbishing furniture; it does not describe changes of state (melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation) or use diagrams/flowcharts.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: reduce waste and keep it out of landfills
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the changes of state in terms of particle arrangement and energy changes: a. solid → liquid → vapor, and b. vapor → liquid → solid
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about waste reduction through furniture makeover, not about changes of state in terms of particle arrangement and energy changes.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: reduce waste and keep it out of landfills
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the role of heat energy in change of state processes
assignedReviews.reason: The card does not explain the role of heat energy in change of state processes; it is about reusing furniture to reduce waste.

copy.en: Having old furniture redeveloped or given a makeover instead of throwing it away is a useful way to reduce waste and keep it out of landfills.
copy.tl: Ang pagpapa-redevelop o pagbibigay ng makeover sa lumang furniture sa halip na itapon ito ay isang kapaki-pakinabang na paraan upang mabawasan ang basura at hindi ito mapunta sa landfill.
copy.bis: Ang pagpa-redevelop o paghatag ug makeover sa daan nga furniture imbes nga ilabay kini usa ka mapuslanon nga paagi aron mamenosan ang basura ug dili kini mapunta sa landfill.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A blown fuse must be replaced with a new one of the correct amperage rating
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe in simple terms how the following human body systems work: muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches electrical fuse replacement and overload safety, which has no connection to the human body systems (muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, respiratory) required by G4-L-1. It is a physics/electrical-safety topic incorrectly tagged as a living-things competency.

copy.en: A blown fuse must be replaced with a new one of the correct amperage rating after the cause of overloading is found and repaired, never with a jumper wire.
copy.tl: Ang pundidong fuse ay dapat palitan ng bago na may tamang amperage rating matapos mahanap at maayos ang sanhi ng overloading, at huwag na huwag gagamit ng jumper wire.
copy.bis: Ang pundido nga fuse kinahanglan ilisan ug bag-o nga adunay husto nga amperage rating human makit-an ug maayo ang hinungdan sa overloading, ug ayaw gayod gamita ang jumper wire.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Pumice rock floats because trapped air bubbles make its density lower than water, while solid iron sinks!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: measure accurately the distance and time when things move using simple equipment
assignedReviews.reason: The competency requires measuring distance and time of moving objects using simple equipment. The card discusses density and floating/sinking of pumice and iron, which is unrelated to measuring motion.

copy.en: Pumice rock floats because trapped air bubbles make its density lower than water, while solid iron sinks!
copy.tl: Lumulutang ang pumice rock dahil sa mga trapped air bubbles na nagpapababa ng density nito kaysa tubig, habang lumulubog ang solid iron!
copy.bis: Naglutaw ang pumice rock tungod sa daghang trapped air bubbles nga nagpaubos sa density niini kaysa tubig, samtang molunod ang solid iron!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Cooking pork until it reaches 71°C inside kills the Trichinella parasites that cause trichinosis.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe changes in properties of materials when exposed to certain changes in temperature, such as changes when wood or coal are burned
assignedReviews.reason: The competency requires describing changes in properties of materials when exposed to temperature changes (e.g., burning wood/coal). The card is about food safety and killing parasites by cooking pork; it does not address material properties or changes in materials.

copy.en: Cooking pork until it reaches 71°C inside kills the Trichinella parasites that cause trichinosis.
copy.tl: Ang pagluluto ng baboy hanggang 71°C sa loob ay pumapatay sa Trichinella parasites na sanhi ng trichinosis.
copy.bis: Ang pagluto sa baboy hangtod 71°C sa sulod mopatay sa Trichinella parasites nga hinungdan sa trichinosis.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The Philippine Department of Health officially recognizes lagundi leaves as an effective natural remedy for coughs!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe the outer parts of plants, such as leaves, roots, and stems and identify their role to get water and nutrients from the soil
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses the medicinal use of lagundi leaves for coughs, not the outer parts of plants or their role in absorbing water and nutrients from the soil. It does not support the competency.

copy.en: The Philippine Department of Health officially recognizes lagundi leaves as an effective natural remedy for coughs!
copy.tl: Kinukumpirma ng Department of Health ng Pilipinas na ang dahon ng lagundi ay epektibong natural na lunas para sa ubo!
copy.bis: Giila opisyal sa Department of Health sa Pilipinas nga ang dahon sa lagundi epektibo nga natural nga tambal para sa ubo!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Pollen from grass and weeds makes your immune system release histamine — and that's what triggers the sneeze.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe in simple terms how the following human body systems work: muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains an allergic response involving the immune system and histamine. G4-L-1 requires describing the muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, or respiratory systems. The immune system is not among these, and the card provides no information about any of the listed systems.

copy.en:
Why does pollen make you sneeze?

Pollen from grass and weeds makes your immune system release histamine — and that's what triggers the sneeze.
copy.tl:
Bakit ka umaatsing sa polen?

Ang polen mula sa damo ay nagpapalabas ng histamine sa immune system mo — kaya ka umaatsing.
copy.bis:
Ngano nga magsipon ka sa polen?

Ang polen gikan sa sagbot mopagawas og histamine sa imong immune system — mao nga magsipon ka.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: An otoscope! It's a handheld medical tool doctors use to look inside a patient's ear canal.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the uses of various science equipment and materials used in simple activities, such as a ruler, hand lens, scissors, balloons, modeling clay, and cardboard
assignedReviews.reason: The competency is about describing uses of science equipment and materials used in simple activities (e.g., ruler, hand lens, scissors). An otoscope is a medical diagnostic tool, not science equipment for simple school activities, and is unrelated to the listed examples.

copy.en:
What tool checks inside your ear?

An otoscope! It's a handheld medical tool doctors use to look inside a patient's ear canal.
copy.tl:
Anong gamit ang pantingin sa loob ng tainga?

Ang otoscope! Isa itong handheld na medikal na kasangkapan na ginagamit ng mga doktor para tingnan ang loob ng tainga ng pasyente.
copy.bis:
Unsang himan ang gigamit pagtan-aw sa sulod sa dalunggan?

Ang otoscope! Kini usa ka handheld medical tool nga gigamit sa mga doktor aron tan-awon ang sulod sa dalunggan sa pasyente.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Electronics and gadgets like televisions, radios, and video games produce sound energy
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate proper handling and disposal of materials according to their properties, such as reusing objects, disposing of excess oil into garbage, and recycling paper, plastic or glass
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes sound energy produced by electronics and gadgets, which is unrelated to the competency's focus on proper handling and disposal of materials according to their properties (reusing, recycling, disposing of waste).

copy.en: Electronics and gadgets like televisions, radios, and video games produce sound energy that we use for information and entertainment.
copy.tl: Ang mga electronics at gadgets tulad ng telebisyon, radyo, at video games ay gumagawa ng sound energy na ginagamit natin para sa impormasyon at libangan.
copy.bis: Ang mga electronics ug gadgets sama sa telebisyon, radyo, ug video games nagprodyus og sound energy nga atong gigamit alang sa impormasyon ug kalingawan.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Gamma rays sterilize surgical instruments
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how plate tectonics can be used to explain the formation of the largest mountain ranges on Earth including the Himalayas and the Andes mountains
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses gamma ray sterilization of surgical instruments, which is unrelated to plate tectonics or the formation of mountain ranges such as the Himalayas and Andes.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Gamma rays sterilize surgical instruments
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: relate the location and distribution of active volcanoes, earthquake epicenters, and major mountain belts to the distribution of oceanic crust and continental crust
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses gamma ray sterilization, which has no connection to the distribution of volcanoes, earthquake epicenters, or mountain belts relative to oceanic and continental crust.

copy.en: Gamma rays sterilize surgical instruments because they easily penetrate through materials, and the energy they release kills bacteria and other microorganisms.
copy.tl: Ginagamit ang gamma rays para i-sterilize ang mga surgical instruments dahil madali silang tumagos sa mga materyales, at ang energy na inilalabas nila ay pumapatay ng bacteria at iba pang microorganisms.
copy.bis: Ang gamma rays mag-sterilize sa mga surgical instruments tungod kay dali silang makalusot sa mga materyales, ug ang energy nga ilang gipagawas mopatay sa bacteria ug uban pang microorganisms.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Basaltic magma has low gas content and is least explosive, while rhyolitic magma has high gas content and is most explosive.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the general structure of the solar system, identifying the names of the major celestial objects, their main features, and general composition
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes magma gas content and explosiveness, which is a volcanology topic. G5-E-11 requires describing the general structure of the solar system and major celestial objects. The card provides no information about the solar system, planets, stars, or their composition, so it does not support the competency at all.

copy.en: Basaltic magma has low gas content and is least explosive, while rhyolitic magma has high gas content and is most explosive.
copy.tl: Ang basaltic magma ay may mababang gas content at hindi gaanong sumasabog, habang ang rhyolitic magma ay may mataas na gas content at pinakamarahas sumabog.
copy.bis: Ang basaltic magma adunay ubos nga gas content ug dili kaayo mobuto, samtang ang rhyolitic magma adunay taas nga gas content ug pinakakusog mobuto.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The respiratory system is responsible for the exchange of gases such as carbon dioxide and oxygen in the bloodstream.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use models or illustrations to explain how movements along faults generate earthquakes and identify and explain which types of faults are most likely to occur in the Philippines and explain why
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes gas exchange in the respiratory system, which is unrelated to the competency about faults generating earthquakes and identifying fault types in the Philippines.

copy.en: The respiratory system is responsible for the exchange of gases such as carbon dioxide and oxygen in the bloodstream.
copy.tl: Ang respiratory system ang responsable sa pagpapalitan ng mga gas tulad ng carbon dioxide at oxygen sa daloy ng dugo.
copy.bis: Ang respiratory system maoy responsable sa pagbayloay sa mga gas sama sa carbon dioxide ug oxygen sa agos sa dugo.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Gas molecules exert pressure on the walls of their container by colliding with them.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify which groups of animals reproduce by giving birth to live young, such as mammals, and which reproduce by laying eggs, such as birds and reptiles
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes gas pressure from molecular collisions, a physics/chemistry concept. The competency G5-L-5 is about identifying animal groups that give birth to live young versus laying eggs. There is no connection to animal reproduction.

copy.en: Gas molecules exert pressure on the walls of their container by colliding with them.
copy.tl: Ang mga molecule ng gas ay nagbibigay ng pressure sa dingding ng lalagyan sa pamamagitan ng pagbangga sa mga ito.
copy.bis: Ang mga molecule sa gas naghatag ug pressure sa bungbong sa sudlanan pinaagi sa pagbangga sa mga kini.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A gas expands to fill all the available space in a room or container

Ang gearbox ay gumagamit ng mga gear para palakihin ang torque ng motor habang pinababagal ang bilis — nagbibigay ng extra force para sa mabibigat na gawain!
copy.bis:
Unsaon pagkusog kaayo sa mga makina aron magdala og bug-at?

Ang gearbox naggamit sa mga gear aron padakoon ang torque sa motor samtang ginpahinay ang bilis — naghatag og dugang nga puwersa para sa bug-at nga mga trabaho!

copy.en:
How do vaccines stop diseases spreading?

A vaccine teaches the immune system to recognize a germ using a dead or weak part of it. When many people are vaccinated, germs struggle to spread — called herd immunity, which controlled polio and measles.
copy.tl:
Paano pinipigilan ng bakuna ang pagkalat ng sakit?

Tinuturuan ng bakuna ang immune system na kilalanin ang germ gamit ang patay o pinahinang bahagi nito. Kapag marami ang bakunado, mahirap nang kumalat ang germs — tinatawag itong herd immunity, na nakapigil ng polio at tigdas.
copy.bis:
Giunsa pagpugong sa bakuna ang pagkatap sa sakit?

Gitudloan sa bakuna ang immune system nga makaila sa germ gamit ang patay o gipahuyang bahin niini. Kon daghan ang nabakunahan, maglisod na mokatap ang germs — gitawag kining herd immunity, nga nakapugong sa polio ug tigdas.

copy.bis: Ang mga glacier nagkudkod sa bato ug nagbilin og mga marka samtang naglihok, nga nakatabang sa mga siyentista nga mahibaloan ang direksyon sa paglihok sa matag kontinente.

Glycolysis means "splitting of sugar," and it is the first stage of cellular respiration where a six-carbon glucose molecule is split into two three-carbon pyruvate molecules in the cytoplasm.

Ano ang ibig sabihin ng glycolysis?

Ang glycolysis ay nangangahulugang "paghahati ng asukal," at ito ang unang stage ng cellular respiration kung saan ang six-carbon na glucose molecule ay hinahati sa dalawang three-carbon na pyruvate molecule sa cytoplasm.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang gipasabot sa glycolysis?

Ang glycolysis nagpasabot ug "pagbahin sa asukal," ug kini ang unang stage sa cellular respiration diin ang six-carbon nga glucose molecule gibahin sa duha ka three-carbon nga pyruvate molecule sa cytoplasm.

copy.en:
Why do hand span measurements differ from person to person?

Because everyone's hands are different sizes! A hand span is the distance from the tip of your thumb to the tip of your little finger when stretched, so a bigger hand gives a different count.
copy.tl:
Bakit magkakaiba ang sukat ng hand span ng bawat tao?

Dahil magkakaiba ang laki ng mga kamay ng bawat isa! Ang hand span ay ang distansya mula sa dulo ng hinlalaki hanggang sa dulo ng kalingkingan kapag nakaunat, kaya iba ang bilang kapag mas malaki ang kamay.
copy.bis:
Ngano nga managlahi ang sukod sa hand span sa matag tawo?

Tungod kay managlahi ang gidak-on sa mga kamot sa matag usa! Ang hand span mao ang distansya gikan sa tumoy sa kumagko hangtod sa tumoy sa kumingking kon ininat, busa lahi ang ihap kon mas dako ang kamot.

Ang usa ka produkto hazardous kung makadaot kini sa panglawas sa tawo o hayop o makadaot sa kalikopan, ug sagad adunay mga warning labels.

Ngano kinahanglan mopili ug himsog nga parent plant para sa cuttings?

Ang kusgan ug himsog nga parent plant mao ang naghatag ug labing maayong tsansa nga mabuhi ang cuttings, kay ang bag-ong tanom nagsugod sa mga tissue niini.

Unsa ang kalainan sa height ug width?
